name: Mcvities TASTIES CASHEW ALMOND
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour(Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil(Palm Oil), Invert Sugar Syrup, Nuts[Cashew (0.8%), Almond (0.2%)], Raising Agents [INS 500(ii), INS 503(ii), INS 450(i)], Iodised Salt, Milk Solids (0.5%), Butter (0.2%), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances and Artificial Flavouring Substances (Cashew, Butter). Contains Cereals containing gluten (Wheat), Milk and Nuts. May contain Soy and Sulphite.
